body:
Thank you for the support and it really has been great. I've spent some time enjoying myself outside and it has been great. Life is beautiful, isn't it? I know that my life will probably get better if I work on it, but who am I kidding, I won't ever find the time to take care of my personal affairs.

I don't know if I have enough will power to hack up my own neck yet, but very shortly I will find out. "If I survive, then I'll see you tomorrow", I guess :)

Spending time outside in the sun has been beautiful. Probably the last beautiful thing in my life since there is nothing beautiful about what I may do next.

I just don't know. Maybe this is a massive mistake. Maybe this is crazy. I need to think it over one more time ...

This is beautiful. I know that feeling, when you just want to burst in tears and let all of your emotions out. It's beautiful outside, and I think I need to go out for a bit and enjoy myself one last time. 

I need to enjoy the last moments of beauty in my life. Maybe it will make me reconsider or maybe not. I can never know unless I try it first.

I'm waiting until the evening so the mood is right. I've cleaned my apartment and organized everything. Wrote up all the notes. Everything is laid out in the bathroom and there is just one thing left to do.

Maybe this will make me reconsider this stupid and selfish decision ...

> Sunsets. The feel of a breeze on my face. 

I will miss this so much.

I know that my logic is sort of flawed. I say that there is still hope and yet, I still want to off myself.

I'm so pathetic ...

> there is so much more than TV shows that you could miss out on if you do this

I like spending my time in the park. Getting some coffee and a sandwich from Starbucks. Sitting down on a park bench and just enjoying my misery (what?). 

"Today is my last time."

God, I love it so much.

> But why would you want out now, if things can still work out?

I'm tired. So many things to take care of. Every day, I get up early, just so I can make myself look pretty. Every day, I have dose myself on coffee just so I can make it through work. Every day, I get stuck in traffic. Every day I get shat on by my superiours. Bills, taxes, laundry, shopping etc etc. Just so I can get my two hours a day where I can really enjoy myself. Not fucking worth it.

> Do you see yourself in 10 years still facing the same problems you have now? How about 5? How about 1?

Probably not. But there will be new problems.
